BiblicalUsage: The word names a crook in a road, and Isaiah uses it once, for God's promise to the blind: He will lead them in paths they have not known, and make crooked things straight. The crooked road is made straight by the hand that leads.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God does not wait for us to straighten our own road; He takes the blind by the hand and makes the crooked places straight Himself.
